title: Swan Pedal Boat Rental at Penn Landing Marina in Philadelphia
includes: US Coast Guard Approved Life Vest
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Wheel Fun Rentals' Swan Boats at Penn's Landing Marina are a charming waterfront experience and a true hidden gem along the Delaware River. Don’t miss this unique way to explore Philadelphia’s historic waterfront, with scenic views of the skyline, passing boats, and the lively atmosphere of Penn’s Landing. Consistently rated as one of the city’s most enjoyable outdoor activities, Swan Boats offer a fun and memorable way to experience the waterfront from a whole new perspective.

All of our boats come equipped with shaded canopies for maximum comfort on sunny days. Our spacious Swan Boats also feature a roomy rear bench seat for guests who prefer to sit back, relax, and take in the scenery while others pedal.

You are welcome to bring snacks and non-alcoholic beverages on board (alcohol is NOT permitted), making it easy to enjoy a leisurely outing on the water with family and friends.
